description: Two trigger delays, each starting a gate of its own length a set time after its input rises

params.text: Sets how long after the input trigger the output gate starts, 0 to 2 seconds
Sets how long the output gate lasts, 1ms to 2 seconds

inputs.text: A rising edge starts the delay for that channel
Scales the delay set by its knob by the voltage over 10V, so 5V halves it
Scales the gate length set by its knob by the voltage over 10V, so 5V halves it

outputs.text: A 10V gate of the set length, starting once the delay has run out

notes: both channels work polyphonically, and an output carries as many channels as its gate input
